name: Lily Design System
trademark: Lily™ and Lily Design System™ are trademarks.
summary: Free, open-source, headless design system: a canonical catalog of 491 accessible components implemented across seven frameworks (HTML, Svelte, React, Vue, Angular, Blazor, Nunjucks), paired with fully styled example apps that demonstrate the same catalog end to end.
description: This is the public documentation site. Every link below is a page on this site unless marked otherwise; the github_repository links go to the canonical source monorepo, where the specification, design-principle rules, and every framework implementation actually live.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR BSD-3-Clause
